checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja reports the entry at 0x0048F140 as int32_t FX_SmokeEmit_23(int32_t arg1) and radare2 finds the same entry with a 37-byte body; the candidate implements that entry and no other.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The retail reads the argument from the stack slot at 0x4 and keeps only its low byte, sign-extending it into the global. The candidate takes the same int32_t argument and applies the same sign extension.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The retail's addresses are reproduced exactly: the global frame flag at 0x005C8BFC, the optional handler pointer at 0x005C8C18 and the handler argument at 0x005C8C1C. The sign extension of the low byte is the only arithmetic and it is reproduced.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The retail writes one dword to 0x005C8BFC and reads two dwords from 0x005C8C18 and 0x005C8C1C. The candidate uses the same addresses and the same widths.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The retail calls the handler at 0x005C8C18 with the value at 0x005C8C1C only when that pointer is not null, and returns the handler's result; otherwise it returns the argument. The candidate keeps the same test, the same call and the same fall-through return.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: The retail has two returns: the handler result and the argument. The candidate has the same two returns on the same branches.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The body performs no floating-point arithmetic; it moves an integer, sign-extends a byte and calls a handler.

limits: Structural verification only: the cfg gate and angr CFGFast. The runtime behaviour is checked with the paired Frida probes.
The optional handler at 0x005C8C18 is only reached when the retail sets it; the port leaves it null, which is the retail's state at load.
reviewed_by: Automated static review (Binary Ninja + Radare2 CFG, signature, behaviour note)

runtime_contract.note: The native writes a global, so the generic scalar probe cannot certify it; the runtime behaviour is checked with the paired Frida probes.
